text: Cassius Durind was a farmer of Silverymoon who became the town's third mayor in the late 6 and early 7 centuries DR. Despite his popularity with the Silvaeren, Cassius was later assassinated, which brought his mayorship to an abrupt end. Even so, his term lasted thirteen winters, which made it one of the longest in Silverymoon's history—tied only by that of the fifth mayor, Tara "Two-Blades" Oakfeller.
Carelman Twopennies was a sentry for the hamlet of Clicking Heels. He was killed in 1370 DR by a boulder thrown by a frost giant during an attack on the hamlet.
Cat of Ordulin and later Lady Cat Wyvernspur) was the wife of Giogioni Wyvernspur of the Wyvernspur noble house of Cormyr.
Canton Karlesad was a human wizard who led the battle wizards of the fortress of Emmech (later known as Undumor) in 1374 DR.
Cernd was a respected druid dedicated to the protection of nature. He served the greater balance during the mid–14 century DR.

Archons, () not to be confused with the similarly named elementals, were an elite group of celestials in the service of all that is lawful and good. Archons were wholly good and lawful and were consistently at odds with fiends of any kind, though they particularly despised demons.
A cave fisher was a lobster-like monster which inhabited subterranean locations and ambushed its prey using a sticky filament similar to a strand of giant spidersilk.

Cerest Elenithil was a gold elf originally from Myth Drannor. He was the offspring of an illicit liaison between his mother and another elf. Because of his illegitimate birth, he was never fully accepted by his family and left Myth Drannor at an early age.
Cellica was a halfling thief who lived in Waterdeep with her adoptive brother Kalen Dren in the late 15 century DR.
Cavatina Xarann was a female drow Darksong Knight in service of Eilistraee in the mid–14 century DR.
Cedric Ravajar was a human man, once a leader of the Red Brigade mercenaries and later a leader of the Vipers bandits.
Chalannos "the Masked" Firehawk was a retired adventurer living in the city of Wheloon in the mid-14 century DR.
Cauln Aumar was a wizard and the third of the Warring Princes of Athalantar in the early 3 century DR.
Cerion Haldoreth was a wood elf who lived in Neverwinter in the late 15 century DR.
The Cephalopolop was a renegade kraken who was the secret ruler of Sloopdilmonpolop in 1370 DR. and 1372 DR
Chaks was the Cloakmaster of Zazesspur for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR.
Cathyr Shintar was a half-elven priestess and eventually the first Queen of Dambrath during the 9 century DR.
Cathakay Shintar was a half-drow priestess and Queen of Dambrath during the 11 century DR.
Cel was a fisherman in the Kabel's Hill community in Quivering Forest in 1489 DR.
Changchub Zangpo was the Sergeant of the Guard for Saikhoi in Ra-Khati during the mid–14th century DR.

Chan Cheng (), titled the Mighty Lord of Heroes, was one of the Nine Immortals who served the Celestial Emperor in the Celestial Empire, the dominant religion of Kara-Tur, particularly Shou Lung. He was the patron deity of bravery, martial arts, combat, and war, and represented the virtue of courage in the Path of Enlightenment. As one of the Nine Immortals, Chan Cheng also held an important place in the Faith of the Nine Travelers.

Chaggrins (), also known as soil beasts or simply earth grue, were grue native to the Elemental Plane of Earth. Because of their destruction of valuable minerals, chaggrins were considered vermin on their native plane.

Torsin Cedric deLancie was a human noble from Waterdeep that served within the City Guard during the mid–14 century DR. He was the youngest to ever be promoted to the rank, despite having never seen a true battle.
Chalco was one of the greatest Nexalan Revered Counselor in Maztican history who reigned in the early 14 century DR.
A catoblepas ( ; ) was a miserable mix of buffalo, dinosaur, warthog and hippopotamus that lived in swamps or wastelands.
Cavil was an assassin member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1357 DR.

Cham Loc was an evil spirit of the Hordelands who once fought with Furo the Mighty, Padhrasattva of Knowledge. In 1359 DR, Koja of Khazari, follower of Furo, named his gray-and-yellow pony Cham Loc, owing to its tendency to bite.
Catlindra Serpentar was an adventuress in Myth Drannor in the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.
Chaldara Immerstar was an adventuress in Myth Drannor in the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.
Celeste was a cleric of Selûne living in Neverwinter in the late years of the 15 century DR.
Celadae was a human cleric of Torm who left her temple to fight for her god after receiving a divine vision.
Cayia was the partner of Desharik, the pirate lord of Brynnlaw, in the late 1360s DR.
Chalipur Hathangos was a wealthy merchant from Sembia, circa the . He owned a shipping fleet and traded in gems and textiles.
Celerum the Black was a member of the Arcane Brotherhood of Luskan and the apprentice of Dendybar the Mottled in Targos in the mid–14 century DR.

Celestian the Far Wanderer was an enigmatic deity from the world of Oerth revered by planewalkers and wildspace wanderers. He was one of the major powers worshiped on the Rock of Bral. He was also called the Star Wanderer.

A celestial creature was a creature living on one of the Upper Planes that bore a resemblance to a similar creature on the Material Plane. Often mistaken for half-celestials, these creatures were not nearly so powerful and did not share a bloodline with any of the true celestials. Many celestial creatures were to celestials as animals were to humans of the Material Plane.
Chandlar Hummerspoon was a half-elven High Priest of Mielikki in the Halls of the Unicorn temple in Elventree around 1367 DR.
Cerandis Greenward was a head scout for the Iliyanbruen outpost of New Sharandar.
Catherine "Cat" Kincaid was the Captain of the Harbor Patrol of Ravens Bluff in the 14 century DR.
Chamon was one of ten guards stationed at the enclave run by the young Red Wizard Hinnar.
Celadaine was once the most celebrated knight of the Iliyanbruen elves, until his fall from grace left him as the malevolent champion of the fomorian king Malabog.
Cedric Buckenwing was an inhabitant of the town of Ghars in Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR.
Cathal Sunspear was the counter clerk for the Aurora's Realms Shop, Waterdeep Way Catalogue Counter in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Chalavon Narthiir was a male companion who worked at the Dryad's Dreams of Mosstone in Tethyr.
Cerunnos, also known as the Horned Lord and the Master of the Hunt, was a firbolg and archfey who was worshiped on some worlds as a deity, a member of the Celtic pantheon.
Chaless, also called the Cruel, was a priestess of Garagos and head of the House of Steel temple in Westgate in 1368 DR.
Chad Leatherman was a harness maker in the city of Ravens Bluff, living on Iron Bell Street, in the 14 century DR.
Chalaratha, who was nicknamed the Dancing Maiden, was a skilled half-elven wizard inhabiting Westgate in 1358 DR.
Cazi Alphelandra was a wild elf giantslayer who roamed around the Savage Frontier in the late 15 century DR, some time after the shattering of the Ordning in 1485 DR.
Celia was an inhabitant of an unnamed village in Faerûn in the mid–14 century DR and the wife of Harmon.
Cauvra Elphaendim was a member of the noble merchant House Elphaendim of Arrabar in the Vilhon Reach in the late 14 century DR.
Lord Challas Amcathra was the patriarch of the noble Amcathra family of Waterdeep throughout the late 13 and over half the 14 centuries DR.
Cerenna True-edge was a guildmaster inhabiting the city of Zhentil Keep during the late–14 century DR.
Cedric Exeltis was the member of the noble Exeltis merchant clan to bring them wealth and power through trade, several generations before the late 14 century DR.
Lord Chan Fu Wi was a human samurai and the emissary of the empire of Shou Lung based in the city of Bral on the Rock of Bral in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Cattl was the shaman of the Nexalan people of Maztica and the grandson of Tecco, the Prophet of Zaltec, who lived in the late 11 century DR.
Chancereene Chaserperi was the wife of Faereldan Chaserperi, and the matriarch of the Chaserperi clan of mages, in the late mid-14 century DR.
Chalathra Nyndra was a high priestess of Loviatar, the Maiden of Pain, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Caulgrith Narueto was a dwarf warrior inhabiting the city of Suldolphor in the far eastern reaches of Calimshan in south Faerûn near the Land of the Lions.
Channas Hornweather was a farmer inhabiting the town of Ashabenford in Mistledale during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Cate was the sister of an eccentric alchemist who lived in her old houseboat tethered to the Fisher's Wharf in Eastway in Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Crazy Celvan was a mad inhabitant of the River District who could be found in the area's rooftop walkways in the late 14 century DR.
Chandra was a half-elf wizard and student of the Neverwinter Academy in Neverwinter during the late 14 century DR.
Ceneus was a Netherese thief who worked as a moneychanger in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in . She took fees of about 6–15% on each transaction.
Chalara was a news hawker who worked for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Chad was a trapper from the town of Mossbridges, who worked as a trapper alongside his brothers in the late 14 century DR.

Cera Whucknolls was a human follower of Oghma and a librarian serving at the Font of Knowledge temple in the Castle Ward of Waterdeep in the mid-to-late 14 century DR, working alongside her sister Aria. She was knowledgeable in matters of religion and human deities.
Chadd was an Iron Consul of Bane who served the Cult of the Absolute in the late 15 century DR.
Cate Quirkilious was a daughter of Thomas C. Quirkilious, the dragonborn proprietor of the Chromatic Scale music shop in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Celia Pendrick was one of the Magistrates of Cormyr, who worked in the towns of Eveningstar and Wheloon in the late 15 century DR.
Catelys Gulchbreul was an illithid of the Absolute from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Ch'kk'ch was the daughter of Ma Festina and an inhabitant of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Cecie was a member of the Dead Rats gang in Luskan in the late 15 century.

Cedric Carrathal was High King of Callidyrr in the early 13 century DR. Like his predecessors, although he held the title of High King of the Moonshae Isles, he was considered to be merely a figurehead by the Ffolk outside of Callidyrr.

Cathla was a bartender of Swordsfall House, a shraehouse (a small restaurant/tavern), in the city of Silverymoon in the Silver Marches in the late 14 century DR. Around 1372 DR, she was a kindly woman of middle years.
Cedric Riker was regent of Corwell in the Moonshae Isles in the mid-to-late 3 century DR.
Cathlona Tabbartan was an Amnian socialite in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Chaladoana was a drow infiltrator working in Scornubel during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Cevalias was a mythic and historic figure and the Champion of Cimbar, who was instrumental in making the city the capital of Chessenta longe before the late 14 century DR.
Chandra Stol was a priestess of Mielikki in the village of Parnast in the Greypeak Mountains in the late 15 century DR.
Celemin Ilver was an elf of the King's Forest in Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.

Ch'ang Tui, nicknamed Long Legs, was the abbot of the Order of the White Crane, a sect devoted to Shu Chia and Path of Enlightenment, in Shou Lung circa . They were based at the White Crane Temple in the city of Kirin, Hungtse Province. He focused on upholding the sect conservative traditions.

Cespenar was an imp who used to serve Bhaal as a "butler". He appeared to have vanished from existence with that deity's death, but reappeared in the Pocket Plane, which Gorion's Ward and party unconsciously created to protect themselves within Bhaal's domain. Cespenar was able to upgrade and create various enchanted items from the right ingredients. Some of the items Cespenar could improve included: * Angurvadal * Carsomyr * Firetooth * Flail of Ages * Ixil's Nail * Keryvian (Foebane) * The Ravager
Celeilol Fireheart was an elf lord of Leuthilspar on Evermeet. He commanded a company of two hundred and fifty elves in Leuthilspar.
Caytran Halvasyn was a half-elf bard and leader of the Society of the Verdant Arrow in 1374 DR.
Celedon Kierney was a half-elf mage and scout active in the Bloodstone Lands in the mid–14 century DR.
Chaid al Farid al Fuqani was a Tethyrian human mage who was an apprentice of Blackstaff Tower in the mid–14 century DR.
Chesslyn Onaubra was an agent of the Harpers who operated within the city of Mulmaster in the late 14 century DR.

Charles David George "Charlie" Stross (born Leeds, October 18, 1964) is a writer based in Edinburgh, Scotland. His works range from science fiction and Lovecraftian horror to fantasy. In the 1970s and 80s, Stross published some role-playing game articles for Advanced Dungeons & Dragons in the White Dwarf magazine, and some of his creatures, such as the death knight, githyanki, githzerai, and slaad (a chaotic race notable for their rigid caste system) were later published in the Fiend Folio monster compendium.
Chaul was an annis hag who inhabited and ruled the village of Citadel Rashemar in Rashemen.
Brother Chaunticleer was a brother at the Edificant Library who sung the Canticle of Deneir at mid-day every day.
Chelryn Sarynnryllar was a sun elf and the mother of the wizard Ashemmi.
Charon ( ), also known as Cerlic, was a major altraloth and the boatman of the River Styx, who ferried souls down the River for a steep price.
Charles Oliver O'Kane was the Lord Mayor of Ravens Bluff from 1341 DR to 1370 DR.

"Lord" Chazdan was a man from the city of Procampur in the Vast in the late 12 and early 13 centuries DR. He was a former noble of Procampur, but later turned pirate. He was among the great pirate lord Immurk's fleet of 100 pirate ships at Dragonisle. The fleet broke apart following Immurk's death in the Year of Embers, 1201 DR. Chazdan arose out of this collapse to become a notorious and vicious pirate captain. He cruelly forced his prisoners to drink themselves to death with quarts (0.25 gallons or ~1 liter) of alcohol.
Chenraya Xorlarrin was a drow priestess of Lolth and a member of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan in the late 15 century DR.

Chond was a merchant from the city of Calaunt in the Vast in the 14th century DR. Chond partnered with six other merchants—Alvund of Ormpetarr, Dzunn of Sheirtalar, Jhasso of Baldur's Gate, Nammna of Milvarune, Pomphur of Almraiven, and Shield of Everlund—to form the Seven Suns Trading Coster. The "Seven Suns" referred to the seven merchants themselves. Chond's own small merchant company was converted into a regional base for the coster. Chond and the Seven Suns were in business by 1358 DR, and still going by 1374 DR.
Chastus Beldrorn was a local herald based in Darromar, Tethyr, in 1372 DR.
Prince Cheddah al-Assad was a member of the royal family of Huzuz in 1367 DR.
Chechu al Khish was an exiled dao genie member of the Shadow Thieves in Westgate around 1370 DR.
Chog the Yellow was one of the two Cloakmasters of Keczulla for the Shadow Thieves around 1370 DR.
Chayne Mulish was a dwarf commander of Citadel Adbar in the late 15 century DR.
Chantos Graybeard was a businessman and wizard in Skullport during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Choin, or Choin the Blue-Nosed, was the bakemono ruler of Panjuis in 1359 DR.
Sister Cherra was one of the monks of the Monastery of the Precipice.
Chezzara was a drow priestess of Eilistraee in the Misty Forest in 1375 DR.
Chizra was a priestess of Eilistraee and one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden.
Chazlauth Yarghorn was a wizard in Waterdeep sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
Charissa Maernos was a priestess of Tyr in Westgate around 1374 DR.
Chiang lungs (), also known as river dragons, were wingless lung dragons that inhabited bodies of water in Kara-Tur.
Charl was a halfling who lived in Neverwinter in the late years of the 15 century DR.
Charri Hunzrin was a drow of Menzoberranzan and the heir of House Hunzrin in the late 15 century DR.

Chanthalas Ulbright was a human priest of Tymora in Baldur's Gate in the mid–14 century DR. By 1358 DR, Chanthalas was the high priest of the Lady's Hall temple, holding the title of High Priest of the Lady's Favor. He led twenty-four priests and sixty-nine followers by 1367 DR.

Chenna Fatrabbit was the head chef of the Elfsong Tavern during the late 15 century DR. Under her lead, the kitchen of the Elfsong produced tasty dishes such as syrup-covered loaf pudding, cheese-and-potato soup and crab cakes. Chenna was known for being particularly cheerful. They supervised two other chefs, Azar Valsheem and Klav Martilmur.
Chien Jang Liang was a wandering kensai in Shou Lung in the mid–14 century DR.
Cholk min Kado was a shopkeeper inhabiting Kadarasto in 1367 DR.
Chanthar Huntsilver was a member of the noble Huntsilver family in Cormyr. He was the head of his house for many years until his death in the .
Chokers were hideous monsters that hid underground and strangled their prey to death.
Chizelo was a young man living in Easthaven during the 11 century DR.
The Child of Silver was an up and coming halfling merchant in Huzuz in Zakhara around 1367 DR.

Chard was a mercenary and a member of the Sailors of the Crimson Sea based in Airspur in Chessenta and operating in Chondath in the mid–14 century DR. In the early 1360s DR, Chard was a lieutenant in command of the infantry.

Chih Shih (), called the Lord of the Sages, was one of the Nine Immortals who served the Celestial Emperor in the Celestial Empire, the dominant religion of Kara-Tur, particularly Shou Lung. He was the god of history, lore, and tradition and represented the virtues of scholarship and respect for tradition in the Path of Enlightenment. As one of the Nine Immortals, Chih Shih also held an important place in the Faith of the Nine Travelers.
Chi Chan was a poet of T'u Lung and writer of Meditations on a Clear Pond. Their work was banned in some parts of Kara-Tur around .
Chasbar was one of the Sardonyx Knights of Grumbar who was attempting to wrestle the ownership of the temple of Myrkul in Undermountain from the dead god's clerics and wizards in 1370 DR.
Chivin was a drow spy from Menzoberranzan in the late 15 century DR.

Charethra Sturnshon was one of the middle daughters of Hlargrim Sturnshon, who along with her eight sisters worked at the Dryad's Dreams, the only festhall in Mosstone, Tethyr in the mid-to-late-14 century DR.
Charlice Churlgo was one of many children of Millie Churlgo who produced the infamous Churlgo Cheese in the Eastern Farmlands of Daggerford circa 1372 DR.
Chelsinara was an influential priestess of Oghma, the Lord of Knowledge.
High Revelmistress Chlanna Asjros was the high priestess of the Palace of Holy Festivals in Selgaunt in 1358 DR.
Chininsk Ambar was a cleric who stayed in Phoenix to the last. He owned a house full of follies, and was served by El-Tarifa.
Cholandrothipe, also referred to as Cholandrothipe the Quiet, was a skilled wizard who once lived in Feather Falls in Featherdale.
High Priest Gondsman Chansibral Thjestnal was ranking priest of the High House of the Wonderful Wheel, a temple dedicated to Gond, in Ordulin in 1358 DR.
Chawus al-Rark was a wealthy merchant and smuggler inhabiting the Free City of Utaqa in north Zakhara in .
Chiganis was one of the Blades of the Old Man in Sentinelspire.
Charvon was a soldier and commander among the centaurs of Guard in Bloodstone Barony in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Patriarch Charisbonde Trueservant was the High Priest of the House of the Morning temple in the village of Eveningstar during the late 14 century DR.
Chief Claw was the leader of the Black Lion tribe of Uthgardt people in the North, for a time during the mid–to–late 14 century DR.
Chee'ah was a demigoddess worshiped by the saru of the Malatran Plateau, considered by them to be their matron mother and teacher.
Conoptora Billon was a human man of the city of Tsurlagol in the Vast.
The "community of the high brows" was a mountain giant tribe dwelling in the Orbrekh in the Orsraun Mountains of Turmish.
Constancia Crownsilver was a knight of Torm and a member of the noble Crownsilver family of Cormyr.
Concettina Delcasio, formerly Concettina Delcasio Frostmantle, was Queen of Damara in the late 15th Century DR.
Colstan Rhuul was an Illuskan human cleric of Bane and one of the most trusted agents of the Xanathar, the leader of the Xanathar Thieves' Guild of Skullport.
Commarth was the commander of the border armies of Sembia but he was also one of the Wearers of the Purple of the Cult of the Dragon.
Crandall was a member of the Targos Guard, active in the early 14 century DR.
Sharp-eye Crub was a loyal cultist of the Absolute who dwelled among others of his kind at the Shattered Sanctum during the late 15 century DR.
Booyagh Culk was a goblin spellcaster and cultist of the Absolute, who served his goddess during the late 15 century DR.
Cratippus was a Netherese priest who worked as a healer for hire in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .
The Crone Island was an island in the Sea of Swords and home to the hag only known as the Gloom Crone in the late 15 century DR.
Cujas was a powerful Netherese priest who taught at the Alchemical Seminary in Eileanar shortly before its destruction in .
Crazyface was an adventuring cleric of foul morals who worked with Shagbag and, at one time, with the dwarf berserker Korgan Bloodaxe in the late 14 century DR.
Fist Crosse was a member of the Flaming Fist mercenary company from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Cressida Flint was an inhabitant of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Crajbek was the Chieftain of the kobold tribe that laired in the infamous Haunted Halls near the village of Eveningstar in Cormyr in the 15 century DR.
Cucathne of Whispered Temptation was a powerful marilith in the 14 century DR.
Crennon Centime was a human wizard and jeweler from Amn researching magic in the mid–14 century DR.
Craster was a young boy living in a logging camp on the Savage Frontier during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Crymara al Rundeen was a human thief and a founder and leader of the Clenched Fist, a Rundeen-affiliated mercenary and adventuring company based in Schamedar in Calimshan in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Crakadan Earthdigger was a dwarven cleric of Tempus, and an adventurer of Ravens Bluff in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Crowler Johns was a hunter from Eveningstar, Cormyr, in the late 15 century DR.
Crodan was a priest of Garagos and member of the Iron Throne in the late 14 century DR.
Lord Culspiir was the ruler of Immersea around 1372 DR, after being the herald of the previous lord.

Dagnabbit was the son of dwarven general Dagna and the lead military commander of Mithral Hall's armed forces, as well as a companion of Bruenor Battlehammer, although not considered part of the Companions of the Hall.
Lord Cutter, previously known as Ravendas, was a ruthless and power hungry agent of the Zhentarim and briefly the puppet tyrant of Iriaebor.
Dagh Illance was a knight and a member of the Illance noble family in Cormyr who rode with Alusair Obarskyr.
High Lady Cylyria () Dragonbreast was a member of the Harpers and the ruler of the city of Berdusk.
Dag Zoreth, born Brandon Caradoon, was a cleric and strifeleader of Cyric at Darkhold in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Daelan Red Tiger was a male half-orc barbarian raised by the Uthgardt Red Tiger tribe. He was an honorable warrior out to prove himself in the world, hoping to amend for his father's orc blood, and to end the exile by his tribe. He carried a spectacular double-axe and also had a longbow for a ranged weapon. When the Wailing Death struck Neverwinter in the Year of Wild Magic, 1372 DR, Daelan offered his services to the Hero of Neverwinter to investigate the plague.
Currag Blackstone was the son and heir to Earl Angus Blackstone on the Moonshae Isles. He died suddenly in mysterious circumstances in the .
Dagan, son of Belgin, blood of Jangarak, was the last High Old One of Dumathoin, final ruler, and Aurgloroasa's instrument of desctruction of the lost dwarven kingdom of Thunderholme.

Dahlia Sin'felle, originally known as Dahlia Syn'dalay, was a young elf originally in the service of Szass Tam in the 15 century DR. She later traveled for a time with Drizzt Do'Urden and became his lover. After her apparent death, she was rescued by Quenthel Baenre to serve as the figurehead matron mother of the restored House Do'Urden.

Daardendrien Medrash was a dragonborn member of Clan Daardendrien, and a high-ranking member of the Lance Defenders. He was a paladin of Torm, and of Bahamut. As of 1486 DR, Medrash was among the most renowned dragonborn in various nations of Faerûn.
Daardendrien Balasar was a dragonborn warrior member of Clan Daardendrien and a high-ranking member of the Lance Defenders in 1479 DR.
Dahl Peredur was an antiquarian and Harper apprentice. He was formerly a novice Oghman paladin but he fell from grace for reasons he didn't understand.

Cymrych Hugh was the greatest hero in the known history of the Ffolk and the first of the High Kings of the Moonshae Isles. Cymrych was so important to the inhabitants of the Isles that his coronation marked the start of their calendar. His reign would come to be remembered as the Golden Age of the Ffolk.
Daern of Hawksroost, also known as the Guardian of the Tome, was a warrior from the village of Hawksroost in the Ride in the late 13 and early 14 centuries DR.
Curuvar the Brazen was a wizard from Loudwater in the late 15 century DR.
Cybriana was a female half-elf magic-user from Shadowdale in the Dalelands.
Dace Sontan was the coordinator of the Spellhold prison in Amn. He was also the architect of the maze below the prison, where the sanity of the inmates of that asylum was tested.
Cythandria was a female half-elf wizard and a member of the Iron Throne during the iron crisis.
Daer'Ragh was a wizard living in Nashkel during the mid–14 century DR.
Dalabrac Bramblefoot was a halfling member of the Fire Knives in the late 15 century DR.

Cvaal Daoran was a member of the Zhentarim and a leader of the Brothers of the Black Fist that went on to lead a hostile takeover of Phlan in the late 14 century DR. He emerged as the city-state's first lord protector, starting a dynasty that would last for over a hundred years.

Her Highness Princess Cyriana Raisa Marela Vajra Eralea Rhindaun was the second daughter and third child of Queen Zaranda Star and King Haedrak Rhindaun III of Tethyr. Officially, she was the Princess of Ankramir and the third heir to the throne.
Dagagoorg was a kuo-toa who was both the king of Sloopdilmonpolop and the high priest of Blibdoolpoolp in 1370 DR. and 1372 DR
Cushtal was a mature adult phaerimm of a small hive ruled by Drullister in the ruins of Synod in 1375 DR.
Curran Corvalin was a halfling in the Doomvault dungeon in 1486 DR.
Currac Dyrr was a member of House Agrach Dyrr of Menzoberranzan in 1358 DR.
Curnil Thordrim was captain of the guard in Elventree in Cormanthor.
Dakim ibn Mu'izzi was a goblin employee of the House of Al-Kamari in Huzuz in 1367 DR.
Daleen Duerna was the duergar Laird of Zortagra during the late 1480s DR.
The Dalai Lama was the spiritual leader and ruler for the nation of Ra-Khati in the Hordelands.
Daidoji Tadako was a samurai who ran a post house in Kozakura in 1357 DR.
Daidoji Rakan was a samurai retainer of the Niwa clan and also a jito in Kozakura in 1357 DR.
Dalia bint Khalil was a the youngest daughter of Grand Caliph Khalil al-Assad al-Zahir in Huzuz, the City of Delights, in 1367 DR.
Cyriana was a queen of Tethyr in the Rhindaun Dynasty in the 15 century DR.
Dackto was a Maztican drider. He was one of the Ancient Ones.
Dagnan was an outlaw member of Broadshield's Beasts in Cormyr.
Daeron Sunlance was a high-ranking Eagle Knight who joined Seiveril Miritar's crusade. In 1374 DR, he was one of the captains summoned by Seiveril to plan the Cormanthor War.
Daffyd was a stonemason who lived in Gracklstugh. He believed he was a Morndin of Clan Ironstar.
Cydaran was a wizard in Teziir in 1359 DR. His father was in the Teziir City Council so Cydaran believed himself the Chief Wizard of Teziir.
Earl Cuthbert was a ruler of Cuthbert Fief in Hartsvale in the late 14 century DR.
A d'hin'ni was a type of planetouched that was the combination of a genie ancestor and halfling (or hin as they were also called) blood.
Cymril was a Harper agent who operated out of Neverwinter in the late years of the 15 century DR.
Dabnay Tr'arach was a novice priestess of Lolth of House Tr'arach in Menzoberranzan in the early 11 century DR.
Daardendrien Nijana was a dragonborn warrior member of Clan Daardendrien, and a member of the Lance Defenders of Djerad Kethendi in 1487 DR.
Daardendrien Turan was a dragonborn of Tymanther and the patriarch of Clan Daardendrien in 1487 DR.
Dahrgash was the savage leader of the orcs who served in the Blood Guard contingent of the Dragonspear army, during the Second Dragonspear War of the mid–14 century DR.
Daeros Dragonspear was a 13 century half-dwarven adventurer best known for having built Dragonspear Castle.

The Curse of Irphong could refer to either of the two creatures that inhabited the lair underneath Irphong island in the Nelanther Isles. A dragon turtle was the first to be known by this name. It was one of the oldest and largest of its kind. It was slain by a kraken in 1363 DR. The kraken appropriated the dragon’s name and treasures. It subsequently attacked ships that passed through the region, especially those that traveled alone and at night.
Cyrdemac was a particularly unscrupulous man who lived in Baldur's Gate during the mid−14 century DR.
Dahaerlin of the Burning Brand was a paladin of Lathander and a champion of the Brotherhood of Light during the 11 century DR.
Daizez was a dwarf historian of Clangeddin's Hearth, an organization of descendants of Clan Melairkyn who were attempting to reclaim their ancestral homes in Undermountain in 1370 DR.
Daland was a wandering cleric in service of Kelemvor, the God of Death in the mid–14 century DR.
Daedus was one of ten guards stationed at the enclave run by the young Red Wizard Hinnar.
Dahalzel was a Bedine warrior of the Raz'hadi tribe who lived in the desert of Anauroch during the mid–14 century DR.
Daimion Nayal was a human merchant and member of the Master Mariners' Guild in the late-15 century DR.

Daghdha, also known as Dagdha, Eochaid Ollathair, or the Daghdha as a sign of respect for his station, was an interloper deity of weather who originated from another plane of existence and was the head of the Celtic pantheon. He had no strong evidence of worship on Toril, though rarely one could find halfling druids revering him.
Dalida al-Jazarijja was a member of the House of Hanif tribe within the Haunted Lands in 1367 DR.
Dalia was a resourceful sailor, and a member of the Mariners' Alliance circa 1372 DR.
Dabbledob Plasterpatch was a rock gnome from Gnomengarde in the late 15 century DR. She was one of the tiny kingdom's foremost two inventors along with Fibblestib Pinebark.
Daerigrol Halindcleave was a roving sharpener of knives and other tools in the town of Thunderstone in the 14 century DR.
Dalagar Longwalker was a king of Andlath, a kingdom east of the Iltkazar Range in the Lands of Intrigue in the 3 century DR.
Cylla Morieth was a magic instructor in Lyrabar on and a Wearer of Purple for the Cult of the Dragon.
Curmavyss was a powerful wizard inhabiting Caer Callidyrr on the island of Alaron in the Moonshae Isles during the mid–14 century DR.
Dalanthla Dreist was one of the leaders of the Kardryn in Yeshpek along the Lake of Steam during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dalaskiviir Sureiet, or Dal for short since everyone mispronounced his name, was a young visionary inhabiting Tulmon along the Lake of Steam during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Daera Nythlyn was a friendly skilled wizard and shopkeeper inhabiting Tulmon along the Lake of Steam during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Princess Daemir was an elven adventurer from the City of Song, Myth Drannor, active before the city's fall in the Weeping War.
Dalin Evenbough was a halfling merchant aboard the Vigilant in 1374 DR.
Dajos was a Captain of the Elite Guard from the city of Samargol in Samarach, circa 1374 DR.
D. Iaroslav was a Raumviran tavern owner who lived in Almorel on the Lake of Mists in the Hordelands in the .

Dalgar, also known as Blood of Iyrauroth, was a draconic orc rogue and assassin and a senior member within the Cult of the Dragon in the late 14 century DR. He was one of the Wearers of Purple who had a seat on the six-person council that led the Cult cell based in Wyrmsmoke Keep in the Galena Mountains.
D'shai was a Serpentguard of the yuan-ti House Sauringar who guarded an abandoned temple of Sseth in Samarach in the late 14 century DR.
Cyphus Ordinae was a monk of the pacifist Guarded Mind Order in the late 14 century DR.
Dalchatha Maereegh was a high priest of Moander, the Rotting God, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Lady Cyrtue was a festhall owner inhabiting Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Dablor Zimmulstern was a scribe inhabiting Waterdeep, the City of Splendors, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Cyrume was a potter in Yhaunn who was secretly a member of the temple of Shar.
Dagnalla Irongard was a powerful wizard and ex-adventurer who retired to live in Yhaunn in the mid-14 century DR when she married into the Thingoleir family.
Cuthric Snow was the herald of Lady Regent Alasalynn Rowanmantle of Tilverton in the 1360's DR.
Daeranatha Dorluu was the olanger, or ruler, of Suldolphor in the far eastern reaches of Calimshan in south Faerûn during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Lender Daija was a cleric of Waukeen who supervised the creation of her goddess's shrine in the Crossroad Keep in the late 14 century DR.
Daerred was a bard leader of the Adventurer's Guild of the Crossroad Keep who led his own adventuring troupe in the late 14 century DR.
Curthryn was a brigand working for the Cult of the Dragon in the mid-14 century DR.
Lightspark was a gold dwarf Harper who followed the High Harper Jaheira to the Shadow-cursed lands in the late 15 century DR.
Custen Meen was a humble cobbler from the city of Baldur's Gate in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Daeclander Illance was the head of House Illance in the late 15 century DR.
Daerendygho Vrabrant was the owner of The Bold Blazon, an exclusive club in Suzail, in the late 15 century DR.
Cyrilla, nicknamed "Loose Lips" was one of the employees of Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
